prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical retro summer lifestyle portrait of an original adult red-haired woman standing casually beside a weathered yellow school bus on a sandy beach. She has loose wavy copper hair and freckles, wears a white cropped tank with high-waisted red athletic shorts trimmed in white, and holds a red popsicle near one shoulder plus a small red handbag with white trim. Include bus rivets, reflective windows, sand footprints, and a distant ocean horizon. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, long soft shadows, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, and nostalgic red-yellow color contrast. If a supplied typography reference is attached, place its approved text in red retro script centered on the tank; otherwise leave the tank unbranded. No celebrity likeness, text not supplied by reference, logo, or watermark.
